public_rationale: The original profit projection excluded stock-based compensation, supporting a limited caution about its meaning. But later reporting, checked against the filing, shows positive June-quarter operating income. Neither record isolates inference profitability or establishes how much temporary compute pricing contributed. The evidence therefore does not settle the full claim about underlying economics and an emerging business model.
limitations: Positive operating income is not net income.
One profitable quarter does not establish lasting profitability.
Excluding stock compensation from a projection does not establish that the completed quarter was unprofitable.
